title: Borrowed Coat
narration: The second-hand coat had a warning stitched inside: if he follows you, pretend your name is Anna. A man followed me and showed photographs of the previous owner outside my home. Police detained him, but a second note thanked me for giving him someone new. Twelve women wearing the same coat were listed as missing. That night, a woman unlocked my flat, collected the coat and photographed me. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. She had never been escaping the stalker; she was choosing his next victims.
